raw_site_text: the departments of Antioquia, Cundinamarca, Valle del Cauca, and the Eje Cafetero (Caldas, Quindio, Risaralda, and Tolima); Cundinamarca region, which includes Bogota
justification: Eligible firms had to be 'located in one of four regions': Antioquia, Cundinamarca, Valle del Cauca, and the Eje Cafetero (Caldas, Quindio, Risaralda, Tolima), with half the firms in 'the Cundinamarca region, which includes Bogota'.
note: Firm-level locations are only reported as these program regions (Cundinamarca and Valle dummies); Bogota D.C. included because the paper states the Cundinamarca region includes Bogota.
